from_node.description: In Beiträge, Machenschaft names a mode in the interpretation/history of beingness in which beings appear through makeability, persistence, production and calculative handling.

to_node.description: Machenschaft is therefore simply a pejorative term for malicious human plotting or manipulative individual behavior.

bridge.statement: Heidegger explicitly suspends the ordinary pejorative meaning and relocates Machenschaft to the Seinsfrage.

ma4.calculability_relation: calculation and objectifiability are later intensifications/effects of the makeability interpretation, not the sole definition
ma4.experience_relation: Heidegger links Machenschaft with Erlebnis as a correlated concealment dynamic
ma4.causality_relation: cause-effect dominance is treated as a historical intensification, not a universal proof
ma4.counterprofile: ordinary human making and engineering practices can be described without assuming they instantiate the full history-of-being diagnosis
ma4.discriminator: the diagnosis must explain more than the generic fact that humans make and calculate
ma4.revision_trigger: cases where makeability language adds no discriminating explanatory gain over local technical or institutional analysis
